source_text: Fifty two mosquitoes were collected indoors in Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo (Congo-Brazzaville) (4°48’38’’S, 11°53’9’’E) in April 2009 as part of a survey for insecticide resistance. The specimens were identified as An. gambiae s.l... The method of Scott et al [33] was used to identify the specimens to species level and M/S status was determined using a modified method from Favia et al [34].
